sources.title: Ace Green Recycling, Inc. Form 10-Q (filed 2026-09-28)
sources.notes: OPENED directly (EDGAR, declared User-Agent). States: 'We expect to consummate the Business Combination on or before October 31, 2026'; forward-looking statements refer to 'the expected opening of its new facility in Texas'. Revenue categories include black mass, lithium batteries and lithium carbonate (trading; no US Li-ion processing site stated).

sources.title: American Battery Technology Co Form 10-K (filed 2026-09-14)
sources.notes: OPENED directly (EDGAR, declared User-Agent). States the DOE grant 'supports the construction of a recycling facility designed to process 100,000 tonnes per year of battery material'.

events.summary: Form 10-Q: business combination with Athena Technology Acquisition Corp. II expected to close on or before 2026-10-31 (not closed at filing; no closing filing found as of 2026-11-03). Mentions expected opening of a new Texas facility.
Form 10-K (FY2026): DOE grant supports a second recycling facility designed to process 100,000 tonnes per year of battery material; no site named.
